_comment: Forecast anchors. {horizon} is replaced at runtime. `branch` = which scenario's probability range this anchor defines (null = context only). `platforms` limits tool calls (budget: 25/run). Queries were chosen by surveying live search results on 2026-08-28 (see graph/DESIGN.md).

anchors.topic: AGI (AI matching expert humans on most cognitive tasks) exists by {horizon}
AI systems that can do most remote knowledge work ('drop-in remote AI workers') exist by the late 2020s (before {horizon})
AI causes US unemployment to reach 10% or more before {horizon}
US enacts binding federal AI safety law / frontier-model pause before {horizon}
AI has trillion-dollar-scale economic impact / mass enterprise adoption by {horizon}
White-collar layoffs or hiring declines explicitly attributed to AI
anchors._note: no platform has a clean market as of 2026-08 — kept so the brief reports it as a known unknown

scenarios.name: Slow diffusion
scenarios.gist: AI capability keeps improving but adoption is gradual; tools assist, workflows change slowly.

scenarios.name: Fast diffusion
scenarios.gist: Current AI is deployed aggressively across knowledge work; many routine tasks are handed to agents within a few years.

scenarios.name: AGI by horizon
scenarios.gist: Systems matching expert humans on most cognitive tasks arrive before the horizon; the job is redefined, not just assisted.

scenarios.name: Regulatory brake
scenarios.gist: Regulation, liability or a pause slows deployment in regulated sectors; capability outruns permitted use.
